title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Rachelle uses \(3\) pounds of meat to make \(8\) hamburgers for her family. How many pounds of meat does she need to make \(24\) hamburgers for a neighborhood picnic?

solutions.text:
If we have \(8\) hamburgers, we have \(\dfrac{1}{3}\) of the \(24\) hamburgers. This means we have \(\dfrac{1}{3} \) of the meat when we have \(3\) pounds. The total amount of meat is therefore \(\dfrac{1}{\dfrac{1}{3}} \cdot 3 = 3\cdot3 = 9.\)

Thus, the answer is E .
hints: The hamburger count triples, so the meat amount triples.
